title: SCA Minhag of the Week 301: "The Final Meal Before the Fast of the 9th of Ab"

chapters.title: Laws of the final meal
chapters.about: One cooked dish, Aleppo custom, Rambam's practice

chapters.title: Ashkenazic customs and objections
chapters.about: Multiple meals, Rabbi Shlomo Luria, Kaf HaChaim Sofer

chapters.title: Sephardic practice and food allowances
chapters.about: Sephardic custom, bread, raw fruits and vegetables

chapters.title: Timing of the final meal
chapters.about: Bayit Chadash, halachic midday, maintaining customs

summary: This class discusses the laws and customs regarding the final meal before Tish'a BeAb. It examines the requirement for a single cooked dish, the practices of various communities, and the views of authorities like Rambam and the Shulchan Aruch.
questions: What is the rule for cooked dishes at the final meal before Tish'a BeAb?
Did Rambam eat a cooked dish before the fast?
What is the difference between Sephardic and Ashkenazic customs regarding the final meal?
Can you eat bread or raw vegetables with the one cooked dish?
Is it permitted to eat a large meal before the final meal?
